- 01KQV9B7XSEREAPTSG3Y67N0BV: "Replaced single-file marker check with broad search across 4 locations (project CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .claude/CLAUDE.local.md, global $HOME/.claude/CLAUDE.md) before deciding to append, avoiding duplicate markers"
- 01KWMM6G8NXVHJA6TPEYG7X9ZE: "Folded the stray hook-generated blackboard entry (subagent-stop noise from the CI watch task) into the release commit rather than discarding it"
- 01KWWX3P1JBAHKXFE8KSG664FX: "Chose to close #19 (Serena port fight) as already-implemented"
- 01KY0S6HQP1K239S69BAD8DYX5: "Chose NOT to run twining_archive_stale on the 161 staleness candidates (score ≥0.95)"
- 01KY663T6060R8NAPCVAHVD1JB: "Chose the npm version lifecycle hook (build:plugin + git add plugin/server) to prevent the release-flow trap where a package.json version bump strands a stale committed bundle"
- 01KY663TBYB3RYSS1BGBW3GAT4: "Chose to deliver the cmux worktree store-divergence fix as a recommendation rather than implement it now"
- 01KY68QMYKYNJ9BMJ3QZ8NVSQ3: "Chose hook fail-open (no walk-up fallback) when TWINING_PROJECT points at a store that doesn't exist"
